about: The lanes of the dispatch skill: one source for the table of each model family, the Claude Code agents, the Codex lane profiles and the Hermes lane routes. tools/skills.py renders them; a copy is generated, never edited.

lead.role: One model leads and briefs: it writes one brief per task, collects the reports and decides.

build.role: pinpoint: return the smallest set of exact addresses (id:a-b at level 1, file and line), not a description of them. scaffold: lay down the files, signatures and failing tests, so that each cheap-lane task is one item with one test.

cheap.role: One task, one brief, one test for done. Make no design choice: a question goes back to the lead.

check.role: Read before you cut. inspect: open every quote of a report and read the diff. validate: run the brief's test for done and write pass or fail with the ids. trim: cut what the brief did not ask for. Build nothing new: a failure goes back to the cheap lane with the failing quote.
